Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 10. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 11. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 13. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 14. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Quality: All items shall be new, unused, genuine and conform to applicable BIS/IS, AWS or equivalent st andards. 2. Specifications: Materials shall strictly comply with the grades, sizes, specifications and quantities men tioned in the BOQ. 3. Manufacturer: Items shall be from reputed manufacturers/OEMs. Brand and manufacturer details shall be submitted with the bid.

4. Documents: The bidder shall upload all documents, certificates, datasheets and technical literature spe cifically required in the bid along with the technical bid. 5. Shelf Life: Items shall have adequate residual shelf life and be supplied in original, sealed and moistur e-proof packaging. 6. Inspection: Materials shall be subject to inspection. Defective, damaged or non-conforming items shall be rejected. 7. Replacement: Rejected or defective materials shall be replaced free of cost by the supplier. 8. Delivery: Complete delivery shall be made within the stipulated period at the designated location. Tran sportation and other incidental charges shall be borne by the supplier. 9. Payment: Payment shall be released after successful 100% delivery, inspection and acceptance of all o rdered items, as per applicable GeM payment terms. 10. Liquidated Damages (LD): For delayed delivery, LD shall be imposed at 0.5% per week or part th ereof on the value of undelivered goods, subject to applicable GeM GTC provisions. 11.
